description: Validate whether recent v2 enrichments (permission_scope_enrichment_v2, temporal_stability_enrichment_v2, tool_description_safety_enrichment_v2 built 2026-05-24T14:12-14:14) have improved signal discrimination. Query mcp_signal_enrichments for recent rows (last 24h) and compute COUNT(DISTINCT score) per signal_type. Report cardinality to service_health.meta. This is a diagnostic-only daemon — MUST NOT modify any data. MUST use write_service query interface only. If any weak signal still shows <10 distinct scores, log warning to indicate v2 enrichments may need tuning. Spec reference: Signal Quality Diagnostic section — weak signals plateau of 3-4 distinct values must be resolved before context_efficiency_enrichment is proposed.
